title: CISA Adds CVE-2026-58644 SharePoint RCE Zero-Day and Two Fortinet FortiSandbox Flaws to KEV

CVE-2026-58644.evidence: as added **CVE-2026-58644** (CVSS 9.8) — a critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint Server — to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a July 19 federal remediation deadline.

CVE-2026-25089.evidence: Fortinet patched CVE-2026-39808 on April 14 and CVE-2026-25089 on June 9, but threat intelligence firm Defused first observed exploitation on June 16.
